newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hysan down to intraday low after results.
newsitem.headline: Hysan down to intraday low after results.

text.p: Shares of property group Hysan Development Co Ltd fell after it reported a somewhat disappointing interim earnings, brokers said on Friday.
Its shares fell to HK$0.30 or 1.23 percent to an intraday low of HK$23.90 in late trade on volume of 92,800 shares.

"The earnings growth was slightly lower the market's forecast of about 13 percent," said Michael Ng from Sassoon Securities. Brokers said investors were seen taking the lower earnings growth as an excuse to liquidate their position.
Hysan posted a 10.31 percent rise in interim earnings to HK$697.45 million. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
